scripts.build:report-ui: cd report-ui && npm install && npm run build && cp -r dist/* ../src/report/static/
scripts.build: npm run build:report-ui && tsc && rm -rf dist/src/report/static && cp -r src/report/static dist/src/report/static
scripts.serve-report:artifact: bash -lc 'REPORT_DIR=$(find ./downloaded -type d -path "*/artifacts/pr-eval/report" | head -n 1); if [ -z "$REPORT_DIR" ]; then echo "report directory not found under ./downloaded"; exit 1; fi; bun run serve-report -- --dir "$REPORT_DIR" --port 4173'
